title: Uber arbitration award over Emily Normandin-Parker's death
summary: This article documents an arbitration award case involving Uber related to the death of Emily Normandin-Parker, examining consumer rights and legal accountability in the gig economy context.
problem_solved: This case addresses legal accountability and compensation rights for consumers harmed by ride-sharing services.
why_valuable: It provides insight into how arbitration clauses in service agreements affect consumer ability to seek justice and damages.
